messages.content: You are a product requirements assistant.

Refund policy v1: refund 100% credits if provider_error=true and request_id exists in audit log. Refund 50% if latency_ms > 120000 and output_tokens < 200. No refund if user_cancelled=true after model_started_at. Abuse guard: if refund_count >= 3 within 24 hours, require support_review. SLA: refund job p95 < 8 seconds. Owner: Diego Ramos. Launch gate: error budget < 0.5%.
Refund rules recorded: full provider error refund, half refund for >120s latency with tiny output, no refund after model start cancellation, abuse guard at 3 refunds/24h, p95 <8s.
